caption_en: decomineral style, flat mineral pigments, no chiaroscuro, pattern equal to form, closed color shapes, patterned water, mountains patterned as dense forest, a swimming figure in a lotus pool beneath a tiled pavilion where robed onlookers lean from an arch, fish and a small boat on the water, flower-dotted hills and a dark cypress behind, lapis blue, malachite green, cinnabar red, gold, jade white
notes_zh: 《Khusraw 窥 Shirin 沐浴》：莲池中泳者，鱼与小舟，纹样山坡与柏树。
